harmonization: chirps_annual sampled to the era5_annual analysis grid by nearest cell (median offset 0.026°; maximum 0.033°)
caveats: The local ERA5-Land annual archive does not contain 2001.
ERA5-Land is a reanalysis and does not replace high-elevation station validation.
MODIS variables are available only for 2001–2025 and retain the local monthly-export provenance limitation.
interpretation_guardrails: Time of emergence identifies statistical detectability, not the physical origin of climate change.
Pettitt dates identify one candidate median shift; they are not causal break dates.
FDR controls multiplicity but does not remove product, spatial-dependence, or model uncertainty.
Environmental co-variation and compound anomalies do not establish causal attribution.
